children: Solidion Technology appointed Jaymes Winters as Chairman and CEO and named Mark Schwartz Lead Independent Director to strengthen board leadership.
Board restructured: Jaymes Winters, CEO, will also serve as Chairman, effective September 16, 2026.
Mark N. Schwartz appointed Lead Independent Director effective September 16, 2026 to bolster independent oversight.
Combined Chairman/CEO role intended to centralize strategic direction and improve execution of priorities.
Board emphasized continuity and independent voice with Lead Independent Director while thanking former Chairman Dr. Bor Jang.
